check: W3 follow-up: ECMWF zero snow_depth - vendor gap or real model behavior? RESOLVED
method: live Open-Meteo Single Runs queries (ecmwf_ifs025, hourly snow_depth + snowfall): current run at Copper/Stowe/Fairbanks/2 CO control cells + archived inits for the confirmed snow days (Stowe 2026-11-13T00:00 -> +4.0in SNWD Nov 14; Copper 2026-11-20T00:00 -> +3.0in SNWD Nov 21). Discriminator: if the same run's snowfall is nonzero while snow_depth stays exactly 0.0, the zero depth is not a model forecast of no snow; control cell with snow cover shows whether the variable is served at all.
findings: ECMWF snow_depth IS served and works where snow cover exists: Fairbanks 48/48 nonzero, max 0.14m, current run.
Stowe archived 2026-11-13 init: snowfall nonzero in 17/47h (max 0.84 cm/h) while snow_depth stayed exactly 0.0 for all 48h - the model forecast the snow; the depth series did not record it.
Copper archived 2026-11-20 init: snowfall nonzero in 9/47h (max 0.21 cm/h) with snow_depth exactly 0.0 - same pattern.
Current run (2026-11-26T00:00): Copper/Stowe/Berthoud/Rabbit Ears all zero on BOTH variables - consistent with a genuinely dry forecast today, not evidence either way.
verdict: SUSPECT SERIES, root cause UNRESOLVED: ECMWF IFS 0.25deg snow_depth via the Open-Meteo Single Runs API is exactly 0.0 at the Copper and Stowe grid cells in every cached and re-pulled run, including runs whose own snowfall output is nonzero and after which snow actually accumulated. The series is therefore inconsistent with the same run's snowfall and cannot be read as a model forecast of zero depth. A vendor-side serving gap/mask at these cells is one hypothesis consistent with the observations (the variable works at Fairbanks); other explanations (ECMWF-side postprocessing, grid/elevation masking, API cell snapping) are NOT excluded, and whether the snowfall series at these cells is itself reliable is UNVERIFIED (nonzero snowfall alongside zero depth does not prove snowfall is unaffected).
consequence: ECMWF snow_depth at Copper/Stowe is excluded from grading interpretation: depth scores there measure a suspect series, not a forecast. Ensemble means at Copper/Stowe are recomputed without ECMWF in results/ecmwf_exclusion_supplement_2026-11-26.json; README conclusions updated. The const_zero_depth baseline stays visible. Cached-run conclusion in ecmwf_zero_check_2026-11-26.json is superseded by this verdict. ECMWF snowfall grading is NOT cleared by this check and carries its own unverified status.
note: Raw payloads preserved at /tmp during session only; payload sha256 recorded above. Re-runnable any time via the same Single Runs queries.
